name: Minase Soushi
source:
“…Talking to me would just bore you.”

Surly, sharp-tongued, and openly dislikes people. Known as difficult and unpleasant to deal with. He rarely smiles, except when he’s painting—when he becomes so absorbed that he unconsciously softens. After Itose and Enishi spoke to him when they first enrolled, they’ve stuck to him ever since; though annoyed, he ends up spending time with them anyway. There are rumors that he resorts to prostitution to pay his tuition, but no one really knows the truth.

View on romance:

Due to experiences in his school years, he strongly dislikes people. Having avoided relationships altogether, he’s never loved anyone, and believes he never needs to.

[Translated from the [url=https://lamina-pla.net/Keylabox/chara.html]official website[/url]]
